ci(cpp): execute and fix the Apple Silicon release package of the native gateway

CONTEXT (you have no other context than this prompt and the repository)
You start from branch `agent-jobs/cppgw-release-workflow-20261118-44297497451-1` of ubiquity/ai.ubq.fi. `cpp/gateway/` is a C++20 port of this repository's TypeScript gateway. A previous agent, working on Linux, added a release pipeline: `.github/workflows/cpp-gateway-release.yml`, `cpp/gateway/packaging/macos/build.py`, `cpp/gateway/packaging/macos/INSTALL.md`, `cpp/gateway/docs/RELEASES.md`, report `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/cppgw-release-workflow-20261118.md`. Its Linux half is proven. Its macOS half has NEVER been executed. You are on Apple Silicon: execute it and make it correct. Read `cpp/gateway/docs/MACOS.md`, `cpp/gateway/tools/macos-build.sh`, `cpp/gateway/docs/RELEASES.md` and that report first.

OWNER POLICY (binding): less first-party code is preferred; mature open-source or standard tools over hand-written ones; security never gets weaker.

GENERAL RULES
- The runner holds a model gateway token: never print it or write any credential to a file. Run tests with an empty `HOME`, a fresh `TMPDIR` and no provider variables. No real provider traffic: use local mocks only.
- Do not edit `.github/` (unless your task says so), the TypeScript, or `cpp/` outside `cpp/gateway/`. Do not delete or weaken tests.
- Model connections can drop: create your report file in the first minutes and commit small steps often (the tree must build at each commit). Leave no build output, binaries or downloads in the checkout.
- Report file: `cpp/gateway/docs/findings/<job id>.md`: what you did, exact commands, real counts and measurements, what is unfinished, defects found outside your paths (report, do not fix). End your final message with the same summary.


YOUR MACHINE: GitHub-hosted macOS runner on Apple Silicon (arm64), Homebrew available, network available. Install what `cpp/gateway/docs/MACOS.md` lists.

OWNED PATHS (you may create or edit only these, plus your report)
- `cpp/gateway/packaging/macos/**`, the `macos` job of `.github/workflows/cpp-gateway-release.yml`, the macOS sections of `cpp/gateway/docs/RELEASES.md`. If `cpp/gateway/tools/macos-build.sh` itself is broken, fix it minimally and say so in the report.

TASK
Run the `macos` job's `run` blocks from the workflow verbatim in a shell on this machine (same commands, same order). Fix whatever fails, in the owned paths. Then: build the package twice from the same commit and confirm the two `uos-gateway-macos-arm64.tar.gz` files are byte-identical (fix timestamps, ordering, owner/group if not); unpack the package into a fresh directory and confirm the gateway executable starts there, with an empty `HOME`, a fresh `TMPDIR`, a local mock configuration and no provider variables, answers a local health or version request, and exits cleanly; confirm with `otool -L` that it depends only on system libraries; confirm the tarball contains the gateway executable, the KV tools, the licence of every statically linked library, `VERSION` and `INSTALL.md`; follow the macOS install and rollback steps of `docs/RELEASES.md` literally and correct them where they are wrong. Validate the workflow with `actionlint`.

DONE WHEN
The macOS job's commands pass verbatim on this machine, two builds are byte-identical, the unpacked gateway starts and answers locally, `actionlint` passes, and the report states the exact commands, hashes and results, plus anything still unverified.
